transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Vikram. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Vikram, I am so frustrated. My phone has been dropping calls every five minutes and I can't get any work done. This is ridiculous!
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you're experiencing these drops, I know how disruptive that is when you're trying to work.
Agent: Before we look into the device settings, could you please provide me with your account number?
Customer: Yes, it is 83587246. My name is Fatima Brown.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Brown. I see your account here. Let's try a quick network reset on your device to see if that stabilizes the connection.
Customer: I've already tried restarting it twice, but it's still happening. I'm using the phone number 94160 47660.
Agent: I appreciate you trying that. Since the basic reset didn't work, it sounds like there might be a hardware issue with the SIM card or the device antenna.
Customer: I just want this fixed. I can't keep losing calls with my clients.
Agent: I understand. I will book a device check for you at our nearest service center so a technician can run a full diagnostic on the hardware.
Customer: Oh, that sounds like a plan. I can definitely do that tomorrow morning. Thank you for actually doing something about this.
Agent: You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? To recap, we have booked your device check for tomorrow. Have a great day!
